equation: P_L(r)=(1-(1-2*epsilon_L)**r)/2; binomial MLE, amplitude fixed to one

confirmation.deduplication: Identical physical arms share shots; double shots for the remaining physical case
confirmation.acquisition: Finish block zero before submitting block one; no confirmation scoring between blocks

previous_evidence: Archived evidence may train/tune; it is never counted as fresh confirmation
selection: Minimum pilot validation primary LER, one physical profile and decoder family per basis; ties prefer released
promotion: All predeclared pairwise contrasts share Bonferroni alpha=.05. A combined candidate must beat released and both components; otherwise use a simpler component only if it beats released, or retain released
diagnostics: R1..7 correlated MWPM, fitted MWPM and recurrent history decoder are each evaluated consistently; no alternate fit window promotion

physical.baseline: Released fused X/fenced Z + data XY4 ASAP
physical.center: Same circuit/readout; data XY4 centered in eligible waits
physical.adaptive: Same circuit/readout; centered XY8, XY4 or XX according to eligible wait length
physical.fast: Released circuit/DD; calibrated fast_constant ancilla pulse, fidelity data; standard-readout fidelity prior proxy when fast SSRO metric absent

qnd: No calibrated QND implementation in active Garnet architecture; not attempted
model_limits: Pauli priors and data-conditioned inference do not model or observe hidden qutrit leakage
tie_break: released, raw MWPM, fitted MWPM, posterior, recurrent; then baseline physical profile
component_rule_reason: Honor the requirement that combinations justify each ingredient; no fresh confirmation existed at finalization
